ideas.pitch: An AI-powered workforce intelligence tool built specifically for Eightfold's talent intelligence ecosystem, analyzing internal employee skills graphs to predict future role readiness and recommend cross-functional project assignments.
ideas.title: Eightfold Talent Graph & Internal Mobility Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since Eightfold.ai is the co-organizer of the hackathon, building an application that directly extends their talent intelligence paradigm using advanced machine learning models is the highest-leverage strategy to impress their engineering judges.

ideas.pitch: An ML-based auditing system that analyzes recruitment resumes and job descriptions for hidden demographic biases, utilizing counterfactual data augmentation and explainable AI to score hiring fairness.
ideas.title: Resume Bias Auditor & Fairness Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Eightfold.ai focuses heavily on ethical AI and inclusive talent acquisition. A project tackling algorithmic fairness in HR directly aligns with their core enterprise mission.

ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics tool designed for university placement cells (targeting IIT and NIT ecosystems) that forecasts industry skill shortages based on historical hiring trends and automatically generates curated learning pathways.
ideas.title: Campus Skill Gap Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: The hackathon is organized by IIT Delhi and Eightfold.ai, bringing together top engineering students and HR tech experts who deeply care about campus placement optimization and career readiness.

ideas.pitch: A real-time technical interview assistant that maps candidate spoken answers and coding snippets directly to a fine-grained competencies graph, providing objective scoring rather than keyword matching.
ideas.title: Skills-First Interview Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages real-world machine learning models for speech and text processing to solve a tangible bottleneck in technical recruitment, a space Eightfold operates in daily.

ideas.pitch: An automated document intelligence pipeline that extracts verified academic projects, certifications, and skills from unstructured student transcripts into a standardized, queryable talent graph.
ideas.title: Enterprise Credential Verifier and Graph Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates hard engineering in unstructured data processing and knowledge graph generation, matching the technical depth required to win at premier institute hackathons.
